description: This file contains mixin definitions for creating caret icons (arrows) in stylesheets, used for UI indicators such as dropdown arrows.

methods.name: caret-down
methods.description: Mixin to style a downward pointing caret with configurable width.

methods.name: caret-up
methods.description: Mixin to style an upward pointing caret with configurable width.

methods.name: caret-end
methods.description: Mixin to style a rightward pointing caret with configurable width.

methods.name: caret-start
methods.description: Mixin to style a leftward pointing caret with configurable width.

methods.name: caret
methods.description: Composite mixin that applies the appropriate caret direction styles based on parameters, including optional display control.
